text:
Maui County seeks applicants for Liquor Control Adjudication Board vacancies
Maui County residents are being encouraged to apply for four open positions on the County of Maui Liquor Control Adjudication Board, according to a July 29 announcement from County Boards and Commissions.
The volunteer board is responsible for ensuring compliance with State and County liquor laws and regulations. It hears and determines administrative complaints filed by the Director of Liquor Control regarding alleged violations of liquor control laws in Hawaiʻi, as well as rules set by the Maui County Liquor Control Commission. The board also has the authority to impose penalties for violations as provided by law.
“Boards and commissions provide residents with a meaningful opportunity to serve their community and contribute to good governance,” Mayor Richard Bissen said. “I encourage qualified residents to apply and help ensure the fair and impartial administration of Maui County’s liquor control laws.”
The roles on boards and commissions allow residents to share their experience, expertise, and perspectives while supporting county efforts to serve the public. The Liquor Control Adjudication Board is tasked with reviewing evidence, hearing cases, and rendering decisions in accordance with applicable laws.
Residents interested in joining may submit an application online through the County Boards and Commissions webpage. Additional information about responsibilities, qualifications, and appointment procedures can be found on the website or by contacting (808) 270-7855.
